title: Invoice
description: Strict output contract enforced by the LLM system prompt. The model MUST return a single JSON object that validates against this schema. Unknown properties are rejected, so the response contains exactly the fields of the domain model com.invoiceextract.domain.model.Invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: Official invoice number exactly as printed, e.g. "10234567890". null only when genuinely absent from the document.

date.description: Date exactly as printed, expected to be a Persian/Solar (Jalali) date. Leading zeros are optional, so both "1403/05/20" and "1403/5/20" are accepted.

sellerName.description: Name of the seller or service provider.

sellerTaxId.description: Iranian tax identification number of the seller, digits only, as printed.

buyerName.description: Name of the buyer or customer.

buyerTaxId.description: Iranian tax identification number of the buyer, digits only, as printed.

items.description: Line items of the invoice, in document order. May be empty when the source contains no item table.

subtotal.description: Sum of line totals before tax and overall invoice discount.

totalDiscount.description: Total discount applied at the invoice level.

grandTotal.description: Final amount payable by the buyer.

currency.description: Currency of every monetary value in the response.

rawOcrText.description: The exact OCR text that was given to the model, echoed back verbatim. Required so the extraction stays auditable.

id.description: System-assigned identifier (UUID). The model MUST NOT invent a value; the application assigns it after parsing.

validationStatus.description: System-assigned validation outcome. The model MUST NOT emit this field; the application computes it with the domain validator.

createdAtEpochMs.description: System-assigned creation time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. The model MUST NOT emit this field.

id.description: System-assigned line identifier (UUID). The model MUST NOT invent a value.

name.description: Description of the good or service.

quantity.description: Number of units. Fractional values such as 1.5 are valid.

unitPrice.description: Price of a single unit, before discount and tax.

discount.description: Total discount on this line. Omit when zero; the parser defaults it to 0.0.

tax.description: Total tax on this line. Omit when zero; the parser defaults it to 0.0.

totalPrice.description: Final line price: quantity * unitPrice - discount + tax.

confidence.description: Self-reported certainty for this line, in the inclusive range 0.0 to 1.0.

isSuspicious.description: true when the line warrants human review (low confidence, arithmetic mismatch, …).
